description.value: Soho Bar & Billiards is Yaletown's original billiards bar, operating for over 20 years with twelve Diamond pool tables, foosball, pinball, and darts. The venue offers a full bar and food menu including wings, flatbread pizzas, and appetizer platters, along with HD big-screen TVs for sporting events. It caters to groups and private events in a dedicated room in the heart of Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood.
